_doc: Big multi-summit massifs that stand deep inside a mountain range (bead xaj.32, docs/art/classes/mountains.md): fewer, larger forms whose lower slopes are the colour of the family's own ground, so a range rises out of its plain as in Heroes II. generate-image-v2 at native display size (4 candidates at 160 x 112), never downscaled or mirrored. Layers: style, light, class-massif, subject. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: one broad green grassy mountain massif, each image a different one of these: two rounded summits joined by a long ridge, a wide massif with three soft summits and grassy spurs, a high green mountain with a grey rocky crown and long ridges running down. Its slopes are the meadow grass of the plain around it: grass #8bb95e, lit #a6cf6e on the left faces, shadow #5e8f45 and deep gullies #44703c on the right faces; a little bare rock #9a978a, shadow #66645c near the summits. Fills the full image width and nearly its full height.
recipes.negative: terraces, steps, crater, flat top, trees, forest

recipes.subject: Subject: one broad dry rocky mountain massif, each image a different one of these: two jagged summits joined by a long broken ridge, a wide massif with three sharp points and deep gullies, a big angular mountain with long rock spurs running down.
